# Packages
```{r}
library(quanteda)
library(readtext)
library(tidyverse)
```

# Importing articles
```{r}
DTS <- read_csv("DTS_articles.csv") |> 
  filter(!is.na(sentence))
```

# Creating corpus for KWIC
```{r}
DTS_corpus <- corpus(DTS, text_field = "sentence") # build a new corpus from the texts
head(DTS_corpus)
```

# Tokenizing DTS corpus
```{r}
DTS_tokens <- tokens(DTS_corpus)
```


# KWIC
# Phrases taken from own thoughts and previous bigrams done on the same csv file used here
```{r}
DTS_KWIC <- kwic(DTS_tokens, phrase(c("deaf", "artificial intelligence", "deaf sentiment", "sign", "sign language", "sentiment", "access*", "accessibility solutions", "disabilit*", "hearing", "language barrier", "RIT", "Rochester")), window = 50) |> as.data.frame()
```
